309	def render_model(model: FeynRulesModel) -> str:
310	    """Render a validated FeynRulesModel to a complete ``.fr`` string."""
311	    sections: List[str] = [render_information(model.info)]
312	
313	    if model.interaction_order_hierarchy:
314	        ih = ", ".join(_interaction_order(t) for t in model.interaction_order_hierarchy)
315	        sections.append("M$InteractionOrderHierarchy = {" + ih + "};")
316	    if model.interaction_order_limit:
317	        il = ", ".join(_interaction_order(t) for t in model.interaction_order_limit)
318	        sections.append("M$InteractionOrderLimit = {" + il + "};")
319	    if model.feynman_gauge is not None:
320	        sections.append(f"FeynmanGauge = {_bool(model.feynman_gauge)};")
321	    if model.vevs:
322	        vv = ", ".join(f"{{{f}, {v}}}" for f, v in model.vevs)
323	        sections.append("M$vevs = {" + vv + "};")
324	
325	    for raw in model.raw_preamble:
326	        sections.append(raw)
327	
328	    if model.index_decls:
329	        sections.append(render_index_decls(model.index_decls))
330	    if model.gauge_groups:
331	        sections.append(render_gauge_groups(model.gauge_groups))
332	    if model.parameters:
333	        # FeynRules auto-declares the mass/width parameters named in each
334	        # particle's Mass/Width spec. Re-declaring them in M$Parameters makes the
335	        # UFO define the name twice, which MadGraph rejects ("name X define
336	        # multiple time"). Drop those duplicates; keep genuine couplings.
337	        reserved = _reserved_mass_width_names(model.particles)
338	        params = [p for p in model.parameters
339	                  if p.name not in reserved or _is_internal_param(p)]
340	        if params:
341	            sections.append(render_parameters(params))
342	    if model.particles:
343	        sections.append(render_classes(model.particles))
344	    for field, expr in model.gauge_xi:
345	        sections.append(f"GaugeXi[{field}] = {expr};")
346	
347	    for raw in model.raw_blocks:
348	        sections.append(raw)
349	
350	    for t in model.lagrangian_terms:
351	        op = ":=" if t.delayed else "="
352	        # Defensive: some (LLM-produced) expressions already carry a leading
353	        # assignment operator ("= ..." or ":= ..."); strip it so we don't emit a
354	        # duplicated operator (e.g. "L := := Block[...]").
355	        rhs = t.expression.lstrip()
356	        for lead in (":=", "="):
357	            if rhs.startswith(lead):
358	                rhs = rhs[len(lead):].lstrip()
359	                break
360	        sections.append(f"{t.name} {op} {rhs};")
361	
362	    env = Environment(
363	        loader=FileSystemLoader(_TEMPLATE_DIR),
364	        autoescape=select_autoescape(enabled_extensions=(), default=False),
365	        keep_trailing_newline=True,
366	    )
367	    template = env.get_template("model.fr.j2")
368	    return template.render(model_name=model.model_name, body="\n\n".join(sections))

I read the paper and SM.fr only. **No cached or reference `.fr` file for this model was read** (none exists in the sandbox).

## Framing note

ALRSM is really a *full* gauge model (SU(3)c × SU(2)L × SU(2)R′ × U(1)B−L + global U(1)S). The harness declares SM.fr as the base file, so I follow the schema rule `gauge_groups = []` and instead (a) declare every new mass eigenstate and every new gauge-eigenstate field, and (b) write the new gauge currents (W′, Z′) **explicitly** rather than through `DC[]`. The U(1)B−L and U(1)S charges are carried as `QuantumNumbers` `BL` and `SS` on the unphysical chiral/scalar classes only (rule 5).

Derived-formula cross-check against BM I (tanβ=4.58, gR=0.374, v′=7799, λ3=0.0196, κ=−31.08, α1=α2=α3=0.0144): my `MWp` → 1458 (paper 1460), `MZp` → 4890 (paper 4992), `MH01=MA01` → 193.4 (paper 193), `MHp2` → 193.4 (paper 194), `MHp1` → 906.9 (paper 907), `MA02` → 907.0 (paper 907). The formulas reproduce the paper's spectrum.

## Mandatory self-audit

    {"name": "vevR", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[vevp^2 - kvev^2]", "interaction_order": ["QED", -1], "description": "vev vR of chiR [GeV], Eq.(C.1)"},
    {"name": "zet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "ArcTan[kvev/vevR]", "description": "zeta mixing angle, Eq.(2.9)"},

    {"name": "szet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sin[zet]", "description": "Sine of zeta"},
    {"name": "gBL", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "gR*g1/Sqrt[gR^2 - g1^2]", "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "description": "U(1)(B-L) gauge coupling, Eq.(4.1)"},
    {"name": "sphiW", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "g1/gR", "description": "Sine of the phiW mixing angle, Eq.(2.13)"},
    {"name": "cphiW", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[1 - g1^2/gR^2]", "description": "Cosine of the phiW mixing angle, Eq.(2.13)"},
    {"name": "alp12", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp1 + alp2", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "alpha12 = alpha1 + alpha2, Eq.(A.1)"},
    {"name": "MWp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "gR*vevp/2", "description": "W-prime boson mass, Eq.(2.10)"},
    {"name": "MZp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(gBL^2*sphiW^2*vevL^2 + gR^2*(cphiW^4*kvev^2 + vevR^2))/cphiW^2]/2", "description": "Z-prime boson mass, Eq.(2.14)"},
    {"name": "aa4", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "-2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*lam3*vevL*vevR*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kap*(vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))", "description": "Auxiliary a(4), Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "aa2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "2*Sqrt[2]*alp12^2*kvev^3*vevL*vevR*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kap*(lam3*vevL^2*vevR^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kvev^2*(4*alp12*vevL^2*vevR^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2))", "description": "Auxiliary a(2), Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "lam1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR*MH^6 + aa4*MH^4 - 2*aa2*MH^2 - 4*alp12^2*kap*kvev^4*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2)/(2*kvev^3*(Sqrt[2]*vevL*vevR*MH^4 + (kap*kvev - 2*Sqrt[2]*lam3*vevL*vevR)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*MH^2 - 2*kap*kvev*lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2))", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "lambda1 traded for the SM-like Higgs mass, Eq.(A.10)"},
    {"name": "lam4", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "lam3 - kap*kvev/(Sqrt[2]*vevL*vevR)", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "lambda4 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "mu1sq", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp12*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kvev^2*lam1 + kap*vevL*vevR/(Sqrt[2]*kvev)", "description": "mu1^2 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "mu2sq", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp12*kvev^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)", "description": "mu2^2 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "aaa", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(vevL*vevR*(2*Sqrt[2]*kvev^3*lam1 - kap*vevL*vevR) + kvev*(2*Sqrt[2]*lam3*vevL*vevR - kap*kvev)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR) - MH^2", "description": "Auxiliary a, Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "bbb", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(Sqrt[2]*kap*kvev^2*(4*alp12*vevL^2*vevR^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2) + (4*kvev^3*(alp12^2 - lam1*lam3)*vevL*vevR + Sqrt[2]*kap*(kvev^4*lam1 + lam3*vevL^2*vevR^2))*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(kvev*vevL*vevR)", "description": "Auxiliary b, Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "MH01", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[-(alp2 - alp3)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) - kap*vevL*vevR/(Sqrt[2]*kvev) + 2*kvev^2*lam2]", "description": "Mass of the light CP-even Higgs H01, Eq.(A.6)"},
    {"name": "MA01", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "MH01", "description": "Mass of the light CP-odd Higgs A01, degenerate with H01, Eq.(A.6)"},
    {"name": "MH02", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(aaa - Sqrt[aaa^2 + 4*(bbb + aaa*MH^2)])/2]", "description": "Mass of the CP-even Higgs H02, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MH03", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(aaa + Sqrt[aaa^2 + 4*(bbb + aaa*MH^2)])/2]", "description": "Mass of the heaviest CP-even Higgs H03, the DM funnel state, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MA02", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[-kap*(vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR)]", "description": "Mass of the heavy CP-odd Higgs A02, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MHp1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(kvev^2 + vevL^2)*(-2*(alp2 - alp3)*kvev*vevL - Sqrt[2]*kap*vevR)/(2*kvev*vevL)]", "description": "Mass of the heavy charged Higgs H1+, Eq.(A.5)"},
    {"name": "MHp2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(kvev^2 + vevR^2)*(-2*(alp2 - alp3)*kvev*vevR - Sqrt[2]*kap*vevL)/(2*kvev*vevR)]", "description": "Mass of the light long-lived charged Higgs H2+, Eq.(A.5)"},
    {"name": "ff0", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH^4*vevL*vevR + MH^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f0, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "ff2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH02^4*vevL*vevR + MH02^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "ff3", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH03^4*vevL*vevR + MH03^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f3, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg0", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g0, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg3", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g3, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "DD1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "1 + ff0^2 + gg0^2", "description": "Normalisation D1, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "DD2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "ff2^2*(1 + gg0^2) + (gg0 - gg2)^2 - 2*ff0*ff2*(1 + gg0*gg2) + ff0^2*(1 + gg2^2)", "description": "Normalisation D2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "xxi", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sign[gg0*(ff2 - ff3) + gg2*(ff3 - ff0) + gg3*(ff0 - ff2)]", "description": "Sign factor xi, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "NrmA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*vevL^2 + vevR^2*kvev^2]", "description": "Normalisation of the CP-odd mixing matrix, Eq.(A.8)"},
    {"name": "UH", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["SCA3", "SCA3"], "orthogonal": true, "value_rules": [

    {"name": "CKMpdel", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "1.2", "block_name": "CKMBLOCK", "order_block": 14, "description": "Dirac phase of VCKM-prime, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSs12", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.5514", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 1, "description": "sin(theta12) of VPMNS, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSs23", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.7392", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 2, "description": "sin(theta23) of VPMNS, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSs13", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.1478", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 3, "description": "sin(theta13) of VPMNS, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSdel", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 4, "description": "Dirac phase of VPMNS, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSps12", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.5514", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 11, "description": "sin(theta12) of VPMNS-prime, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSps23", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.7392", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 12, "description": "sin(theta23) of VPMNS-prime, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSps13", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.1478", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 13, "description": "sin(theta13) of VPMNS-prime, Eq.(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSpdel", "parameter_type": "External", "value": "0.", "block_name": "PMNSBLOCK", "order_block": 14, "description": "Dirac phase of VPMNS-prime, Eq.(C.3)"},

    {"name": "bet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "ArcTan[tb]", "description": "beta mixing angle, Eq.(2.9)"},
    {"name": "cbe", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Cos[bet]", "description": "Cosine of beta"},
    {"name": "sbe", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sin[bet]", "description": "Sine of beta"},
    {"name": "vevL", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vev*cbe", "interaction_order": ["QED", -1], "description": "vev vL of chiL [GeV], Eq.(C.1)"},
    {"name": "kvev", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vev*sbe", "interaction_order": ["QED", -1], "description": "vev k of phi02 [GeV], Eq.(C.1)"},
    {"name": "vevR", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[vevp^2 - kvev^2]", "interaction_order": ["QED", -1], "description": "vev vR of chiR [GeV], Eq.(C.1)"},
    {"name": "zet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "ArcTan[kvev/vevR]", "description": "zeta mixing angle, Eq.(2.9)"},
    {"name": "czet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Cos[zet]", "description": "Cosine of zeta"},
    {"name": "szet", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sin[zet]", "description": "Sine of zeta"},
    {"name": "gBL", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "gR*g1/Sqrt[gR^2 - g1^2]", "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "description": "U(1)(B-L) gauge coupling, Eq.(4.1)"},
    {"name": "sphiW", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "g1/gR", "description": "Sine of the phiW mixing angle, Eq.(2.13)"},
    {"name": "cphiW", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[1 - g1^2/gR^2]", "description": "Cosine of the phiW mixing angle, Eq.(2.13)"},
    {"name": "alp12", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp1 + alp2", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "alpha12 = alpha1 + alpha2, Eq.(A.1)"},
    {"name": "MWp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "gR*vevp/2", "description": "W-prime boson mass, Eq.(2.10)"},
    {"name": "MZp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(gBL^2*sphiW^2*vevL^2 + gR^2*(cphiW^4*kvev^2 + vevR^2))/cphiW^2]/2", "description": "Z-prime boson mass, Eq.(2.14)"},
    {"name": "aa4", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "-2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*lam3*vevL*vevR*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kap*(vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))", "description": "Auxiliary a(4), Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "aa2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "2*Sqrt[2]*alp12^2*kvev^3*vevL*vevR*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kap*(lam3*vevL^2*vevR^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kvev^2*(4*alp12*vevL^2*vevR^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2))", "description": "Auxiliary a(2), Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "lam1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR*MH^6 + aa4*MH^4 - 2*aa2*MH^2 - 4*alp12^2*kap*kvev^4*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2)/(2*kvev^3*(Sqrt[2]*vevL*vevR*MH^4 + (kap*kvev - 2*Sqrt[2]*lam3*vevL*vevR)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*MH^2 - 2*kap*kvev*lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2))", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "lambda1 traded for the SM-like Higgs mass, Eq.(A.10)"},
    {"name": "lam4", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "lam3 - kap*kvev/(Sqrt[2]*vevL*vevR)", "interaction_order": ["QED", 2], "description": "lambda4 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "mu1sq", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp12*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) + kvev^2*lam1 + kap*vevL*vevR/(Sqrt[2]*kvev)", "description": "mu1^2 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "mu2sq", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "alp12*kvev^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)", "description": "mu2^2 from minimisation, Eq.(A.3)"},
    {"name": "aaa", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(vevL*vevR*(2*Sqrt[2]*kvev^3*lam1 - kap*vevL*vevR) + kvev*(2*Sqrt[2]*lam3*vevL*vevR - kap*kvev)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR) - MH^2", "description": "Auxiliary a, Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "bbb", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(Sqrt[2]*kap*kvev^2*(4*alp12*vevL^2*vevR^2 + lam3*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2) + (4*kvev^3*(alp12^2 - lam1*lam3)*vevL*vevR + Sqrt[2]*kap*(kvev^4*lam1 + lam3*vevL^2*vevR^2))*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(kvev*vevL*vevR)", "description": "Auxiliary b, Eq.(A.12)"},
    {"name": "MH01", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[-(alp2 - alp3)*(vevL^2 + vevR^2) - kap*vevL*vevR/(Sqrt[2]*kvev) + 2*kvev^2*lam2]", "description": "Mass of the light CP-even Higgs H01, Eq.(A.6)"},
    {"name": "MA01", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "MH01", "description": "Mass of the light CP-odd Higgs A01, degenerate with H01, Eq.(A.6)"},
    {"name": "MH02", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(aaa - Sqrt[aaa^2 + 4*(bbb + aaa*MH^2)])/2]", "description": "Mass of the CP-even Higgs H02, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MH03", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(aaa + Sqrt[aaa^2 + 4*(bbb + aaa*MH^2)])/2]", "description": "Mass of the heaviest CP-even Higgs H03, the DM funnel state, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MA02", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[-kap*(vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2))/(Sqrt[2]*kvev*vevL*vevR)]", "description": "Mass of the heavy CP-odd Higgs A02, Eq.(A.11)"},
    {"name": "MHp1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(kvev^2 + vevL^2)*(-2*(alp2 - alp3)*kvev*vevL - Sqrt[2]*kap*vevR)/(2*kvev*vevL)]", "description": "Mass of the heavy charged Higgs H1+, Eq.(A.5)"},
    {"name": "MHp2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[(kvev^2 + vevR^2)*(-2*(alp2 - alp3)*kvev*vevR - Sqrt[2]*kap*vevL)/(2*kvev*vevR)]", "description": "Mass of the light long-lived charged Higgs H2+, Eq.(A.5)"},
    {"name": "ff0", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH^4*vevL*vevR + MH^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f0, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "ff2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH02^4*vevL*vevR + MH02^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "ff3", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "(2*MH03^4*vevL*vevR + MH03^2*(vevL^2 + vevR^2)*(Sqrt[2]*kvev*kap - 4*vevL*vevR*lam3) - 2*Sqrt[2]*kvev*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)^2*lam3*kap)/(vevR*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary f3, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg0", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g0, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH02^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "gg3", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "vevL*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevR^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevR^2*lam3)*(vevL^2 - vevR^2)*kap)/(vevR*(MH03^2*(4*kvev*vevL*vevR*alp12 + Sqrt[2]*vevL^2*kap) + 2*Sqrt[2]*(kvev^2*alp12 + vevL^2*lam3)*(vevR^2 - vevL^2)*kap))", "description": "Auxiliary g3, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "DD1", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "1 + ff0^2 + gg0^2", "description": "Normalisation D1, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "DD2", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "ff2^2*(1 + gg0^2) + (gg0 - gg2)^2 - 2*ff0*ff2*(1 + gg0*gg2) + ff0^2*(1 + gg2^2)", "description": "Normalisation D2, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "xxi", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sign[gg0*(ff2 - ff3) + gg2*(ff3 - ff0) + gg3*(ff0 - ff2)]", "description": "Sign factor xi, Eq.(A.9)"},
    {"name": "NrmA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "value": "Sqrt[vevL^2*vevR^2 + kvev^2*vevL^2 + vevR^2*kvev^2]", "description": "Normalisation of the CP-odd mixing matrix, Eq.(A.8)"},
    {"name": "UH", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["SCA3", "SCA3"], "orthogonal": true, "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "UH[1,1]", "rhs": "ff0/Sqrt[DD1]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[1,2]", "rhs": "(ff2*(1 + gg0^2) - ff0*(1 + gg0*gg2))/Sqrt[DD1*DD2]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[1,3]", "rhs": "xxi*(gg2 - gg0)/Sqrt[DD2]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[2,1]", "rhs": "gg0/Sqrt[DD1]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[2,2]", "rhs": "(gg2*(1 + ff0^2) - gg0*(1 + ff0*ff2))/Sqrt[DD1*DD2]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[2,3]", "rhs": "xxi*(ff0 - ff2)/Sqrt[DD2]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[3,1]", "rhs": "1/Sqrt[DD1]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[3,2]", "rhs": "(ff0^2 + gg0^2 - ff0*ff2 - gg0*gg2)/Sqrt[DD1*DD2]"},
      {"lhs": "UH[3,3]", "rhs": "xxi*(gg0*ff2 - gg2*ff0)/Sqrt[DD2]"}
    ], "description": "3x3 CP-even Higgs mixing matrix UH acting on (H00,H02,H03), Eqs.(2.7),(A.8)"},
    {"name": "UA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["SCA3", "SCA3"], "orthogonal": true, "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "UA[1,1]", "rhs": "-kvev/Sqrt[kvev^2 + vevR^2]"},
      {"lhs": "UA[1,2]", "rhs": "kvev*vevR^2/(Sqrt[kvev^2 + vevR^2]*NrmA)"},
      {"lhs": "UA[1,3]", "rhs": "vevR*vevL/NrmA"},
      {"lhs": "UA[2,1]", "rhs": "0"},
      {"lhs": "UA[2,2]", "rhs": "vevL*Sqrt[kvev^2 + vevR^2]/NrmA"},
      {"lhs": "UA[2,3]", "rhs": "-kvev*vevR/NrmA"},
      {"lhs": "UA[3,1]", "rhs": "vevR/Sqrt[kvev^2 + vevR^2]"},
      {"lhs": "UA[3,2]", "rhs": "kvev^2*vevR/(Sqrt[kvev^2 + vevR^2]*NrmA)"},
      {"lhs": "UA[3,3]", "rhs": "kvev*vevL/NrmA"}
    ], "description": "3x3 CP-odd Higgs mixing matrix UA acting on (G01,G02,A02), Eqs.(2.7),(A.8)"},
    {"name": "CKMp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "unitary": true, "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "CKMp[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-CKMps12^2]*Sqrt[1-CKMps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[1,2]", "rhs": "CKMps12*Sqrt[1-CKMps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[1,3]", "rhs": "CKMps13*Exp[-I*CKMpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[2,1]", "rhs": "-CKMps12*Sqrt[1-CKMps23^2] - Sqrt[1-CKMps12^2]*CKMps23*CKMps13*Exp[I*CKMpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-CKMps12^2]*Sqrt[1-CKMps23^2] - CKMps12*CKMps23*CKMps13*Exp[I*CKMpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[2,3]", "rhs": "CKMps23*Sqrt[1-CKMps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[3,1]", "rhs": "CKMps12*CKMps23 - Sqrt[1-CKMps12^2]*Sqrt[1-CKMps23^2]*CKMps13*Exp[I*CKMpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[3,2]", "rhs": "-Sqrt[1-CKMps12^2]*CKMps23 - CKMps12*Sqrt[1-CKMps23^2]*CKMps13*Exp[I*CKMpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "CKMp[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-CKMps23^2]*Sqrt[1-CKMps13^2]"}
    ], "description": "VCKM-prime rotation of the right-handed exotic down-type quarks, Eqs.(2.15),(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNS", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "unitary": true, "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "PMNS[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSs12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSs13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[1,2]", "rhs": "PMNSs12*Sqrt[1-PMNSs13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[1,3]", "rhs": "PMNSs13*Exp[-I*PMNSdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[2,1]", "rhs": "-PMNSs12*Sqrt[1-PMNSs23^2] - Sqrt[1-PMNSs12^2]*PMNSs23*PMNSs13*Exp[I*PMNSdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSs12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSs23^2] - PMNSs12*PMNSs23*PMNSs13*Exp[I*PMNSdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[2,3]", "rhs": "PMNSs23*Sqrt[1-PMNSs13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[3,1]", "rhs": "PMNSs12*PMNSs23 - Sqrt[1-PMNSs12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSs23^2]*PMNSs13*Exp[I*PMNSdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[3,2]", "rhs": "-Sqrt[1-PMNSs12^2]*PMNSs23 - PMNSs12*Sqrt[1-PMNSs23^2]*PMNSs13*Exp[I*PMNSdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNS[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSs23^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSs13^2]"}
    ], "description": "VPMNS rotation of the left-handed neutrinos, Eqs.(2.15),(C.3)"},
    {"name": "PMNSp", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "unitary": true, "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSps12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[1,2]", "rhs": "PMNSps12*Sqrt[1-PMNSps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[1,3]", "rhs": "PMNSps13*Exp[-I*PMNSpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[2,1]", "rhs": "-PMNSps12*Sqrt[1-PMNSps23^2] - Sqrt[1-PMNSps12^2]*PMNSps23*PMNSps13*Exp[I*PMNSpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSps12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSps23^2] - PMNSps12*PMNSps23*PMNSps13*Exp[I*PMNSpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[2,3]", "rhs": "PMNSps23*Sqrt[1-PMNSps13^2]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[3,1]", "rhs": "PMNSps12*PMNSps23 - Sqrt[1-PMNSps12^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSps23^2]*PMNSps13*Exp[I*PMNSpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[3,2]", "rhs": "-Sqrt[1-PMNSps12^2]*PMNSps23 - PMNSps12*Sqrt[1-PMNSps23^2]*PMNSps13*Exp[I*PMNSpdel]"},
      {"lhs": "PMNSp[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[1-PMNSps23^2]*Sqrt[1-PMNSps13^2]"}
    ], "description": "VPMNS-prime rotation of the right-handed scotinos, Eqs.(2.15),(C.3)"},
    {"name": "yuA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "definitions": [{"lhs": "yuA[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ]", "rhs": "0 /; (i =!= j)", "delayed": true}], "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "yuA[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MU/kvev"},
      {"lhs": "yuA[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MC/kvev"},
      {"lhs": "yuA[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MT/kvev"}
    ], "description": "Up-type Yukawa matrix Yu of Eq.(2.3), mass generated by the k vev, Eq.(B.2)"},
    {"name": "ydA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "definitions": [{"lhs": "ydA[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ]", "rhs": "0 /; (i =!= j)", "delayed": true}], "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "ydA[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MD/vevL"},
      {"lhs": "ydA[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MS/vevL"},
      {"lhs": "ydA[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MB/vevL"}
    ], "description": "Down-type Yukawa matrix Yd of Eq.(2.3), mass generated by the vL vev, Eq.(B.2)"},
    {"name": "yeA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "definitions": [{"lhs": "yeA[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ]", "rhs": "0 /; (i =!= j)", "delayed": true}], "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "yeA[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*Me/kvev"},
      {"lhs": "yeA[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MMU/kvev"},
      {"lhs": "yeA[3,3]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*MTA/kvev"}
    ], "description": "Charged-lepton Yukawa matrix Ye of Eq.(2.3), mass generated by the k vev, Eq.(B.2)"},
    {"name": "yvA", "parameter_type": "Internal", "indices": ["Generation", "Generation"], "interaction_order": ["QED", 1], "definitions": [{"lhs": "yvA[i_?NumericQ, j_?NumericQ]", "rhs": "0 /; (i =!= j)", "delayed": true}], "value_rules": [
      {"lhs": "yvA[1,1]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*Mve/vevL"},
      {"lhs": "yvA[2,2]", "rhs": "Sqrt[2]*Mvm/vevL"},
